headline: Two senior Iranian officials confirm Tehran is preparing to target US diplomats and personnel
dek: Two senior Iranian officials told the NYT Tehran is preparing to target US diplomats and personnel, and that targeting American officials was considered 'fair game' given the number of Iranian officials killed by the US and Israel. A US official told the NYT there is evidence Tehran has operatives…
sources: The New York Times, citing two senior Iranian officials (one IRGC member), via Times of Israel liveblog
fault_line: Deterrence or escalation: is Tehran warning Washington off a new strike, or preparing retaliation that makes a US-Iran deal impossible?

sections.what_happened: Two senior Iranian officials told the NYT Tehran is preparing to target US diplomats and personnel, and that targeting American officials was considered 'fair game' given the number of Iranian officials killed by the US and Israel. A US official told the NYT there is evidence Tehran has operatives in the US who are 'not just simply Iranian nationals.' This follows DNI Jay Clayton's Oct 23 memo (recorded totw-20261025-0800-02) that Iran has 'substantially increased efforts to target US personnel' overseas with lethal plots.
sections.what_verified: 1 distinct publisher family counts: NYT T2. Times of Israel T3 carries the NYT report -- same chain, not independent corroboration. The Clayton memo (recorded 0800-02) is consistent context, not confirmation of the officials' claims.
sections.what_disputed: Both Iranian sources are unnamed; no named Iranian official has publicly confirmed a targeting policy, and no specific plot, target or timeline is given. The claim could be signalling/deterrence rather than an operational plan. No US casualty or incident is reported to corroborate an active campaign.
sections.why_matters: Washington's own warning, now echoed from inside Tehran: US diplomats are in the crosshairs as the Sunday fork stays open.
sections.context: Background: NEW to scans (in-window via Times of Israel liveblog) -- NYT: two senior Iranian officials confirm Tehran is preparing to target US diplomats and personnel; targeting called 'fair game'

totw_analysis: Our read: Washington's own warning, now echoed from inside Tehran: US diplomats are in the crosshairs as the Sunday fork stays open. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Deterrence or escalation: is Tehran warning Washington off a new strike, or preparing retaliation that makes a US-Iran deal impossible?
